changed_fields.before: Empty Session slot on a MIDI track; double-click or Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s). In Arrangement select an empty timespan on a MIDI track and invoke the same command.
changed_fields.after: Empty Session slot on a MIDI track; double-click or Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s). In Arrangement select an empty timespan on a MIDI track and invoke the same command. Explicit remaining entries are Create > Insert Empty MIDI Clip(s) on an empty Session slot, Arrangement track-display double-click, and CtrlShiftM Win/CmdShiftM Mac on an empty Arrangement MIDI timespan.

changed_fields.before: Focused Notes editor; toggle Draw Mode with B; click empty grid, then existing note. In inactive Draw Mode double-click empty grid or an existing note.
changed_fields.after: Focused Notes editor; toggle Draw Mode with B; click empty grid, then existing note. In inactive Draw Mode double-click empty grid or an existing note. Explicit Draw entries are Control Bar button and focused B; Pitch Lock preference state is declared.

changed_fields.before: Draw adds notes; clicking an existing note in Draw Mode deletes it. Outside Draw Mode double-click adds or deletes respectively. Pitch-lock preference confines a draw gesture to one pitch; Alt/Option temporarily reverses pitch-lock behavior.
changed_fields.after: Draw adds notes; clicking an existing note in Draw Mode deletes it. Outside Draw Mode double-click adds or deletes respectively. Pitch-lock preference confines a draw gesture to one pitch; Alt/Option temporarily reverses pitch-lock behavior. With Pitch Lock OFF drawing is melodic and Alt Win/Option Mac temporarily enables pitch lock. Melodic overdraw erases an existing note; pitch-locked backtracking erases drawn notes. Focused Options/context labels state Draw Mode (Pitch Lock On/Off).

changed_fields.before: Drag selected note or resize edge with grid on; toggle grid off or use the temporary grid modifier.
changed_fields.after: Drag selected note or resize edge with grid on; toggle grid off or use the temporary grid modifier. Exact grid entry controls include Grid Settings button, Options Snap to Grid and Ctrl4 Win/Cmd4 Mac.

changed_fields.before: Select notes, drag or use arrows; paste clipboard notes at insert marker; place a same-pitch new note over an old note.
changed_fields.after: Select notes, drag or use arrows; paste clipboard notes at insert marker; place a same-pitch new note over an old note. Copy-drag uses Ctrl Win/Option Mac, including introducing the modifier after a drag starts.

changed_fields.before: Horizontal movement changes time; vertical movement changes pitch. Paste begins at insert marker. A new note overlapping the old note start replaces the old note; overlap limited to the old note end shortens the old note. Exact touching-edge and expression collision results U.
changed_fields.after: Horizontal movement changes time; vertical movement changes pitch. Paste begins at insert marker. A new note overlapping the old note start replaces the old note; overlap limited to the old note end shortens the old note. Exact touching-edge and expression collision results U. The admitted modifier drag makes copies at the destination; exact identities and collisions U.

changed_fields.before: Select notes and invoke Deactivate or 0, then 0 again. Edit notes imported from a MIDI file and invoke Undo.
changed_fields.after: Select notes and invoke Deactivate or 0, then 0 again. Edit notes imported from a MIDI file and invoke Undo. Deactivate Note(s) entries include Edit menu, piano-ruler context and MIDI Note Editor context.

changed_fields.before: Invoke Randomize with selected notes or none; set Velocity Deviation on a note.
changed_fields.after: Invoke Randomize with selected notes or none; set Velocity Deviation on a note. Randomize can target selected notes or selected markers; validating a typed Randomization Amount with Enter is a separate entry.

changed_fields.before: Randomize changes selected velocities or all notes if none selected, within the stated amount relative to originals. Deviation is a playback-time range; velocity 60 with +20 yields values in 60..80. Double-click a deviated marker resets deviation to zero. Random distribution/seed/repeatability U.
changed_fields.after: Randomize changes selected velocities or all notes if none selected, within the stated amount relative to originals. Deviation is a playback-time range; velocity 60 with +20 yields values in 60..80. Double-click a deviated marker resets deviation to zero. Random distribution/seed/repeatability U. Validating the typed amount with Enter triggers randomization; no guaranteed changed realization follows.
